outcome: Association between hematocrit value and birth weight, gestational age, newborn gender, placenta position, and preoperative maternal hemoglobin level
cohort: 47 patients with placenta previa and 43 control patients who gave birth with a cesarean section at 34-38 weeks of gestation
finding: This study found that placenta previa was associated with lower hematocrit values in newborns, even in the absence of antepartum or intrapartum hemorrhage.
